profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Garmin
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with a proven track record of leading high-performing teams, focused on system design and scalable architecture across modern and legacy systems.

positions.title: Lead Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
positions.description:
Led a UI team responsible for feature development across 6 codebases, leveraging modern frontend technologies such as react, Next.js, and Vercel. 

Architected and implemented codebase structures and development standards, ensuring continuity and consistency across 6 diverse projects.

Authored and deployed over 750 unit and integration tests across projects, significantly enhancing project reliability and functional accuracy.

Implemented real-time error monitoring and observability tools to ensure optimal health and performance of all projects.

Spearheaded the development of a comprehensive design system and code library, featuring reusable components, utilities, and theming, boosting code efficiency across 6 projects.

Serving as the primary code reviewer and UI lead in all planning discussions, ensuring adherence to best practices and alignment with product goals.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Next.js · TypeScript · Software Development

positions.title: Lead Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
positions.description:
Led a team of 4 engineers, focusing on team growth, keeping projects on track, and sticking to tech best practices.

Spearheaded the update of our Angular codebase to align with the latest design system.

Consistently promoted strong documentation to break down knowledge gaps and ensure technical consistency across the board.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · TypeScript · AngularJS · Software Development

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Initiated and directed efforts to establish robust documentation and coding standards, significantly accelerating team onboarding and operational efficiency.

Conducted a thorough review of frontend architecture, formulating quantifiable objectives and a strategic plan to deliver a best-in-class user experience.

Led the architectural design and setup for a substantial portal overhaul, leveraging Next.js, Typescript, Storybook, and GraphQL technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · SASS · TypeScript · Software Development

positions.title: UI Engineer (Project Lead)
positions.description:
Orchestrated an intricate code overhaul for legacy elements within a sizable web application, elevating maintainability, modularity, and overall code quality.

Conducted and executed a wide-ranging accessibility audit for a key client's web application, bringing it up to industry standards and enhancing user accessibility.

Engineered a component library and web application for a high-profile client using Next.js and Storybook, ensuring efficient and consistent development.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Next.js · SASS · Software Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed modern web applications for multiple clients, utilizing React, Vue and Shopify.

Engineered a cross-platform React Native application tailored for local company, enhancing their operational efficiency.

Administered and introduced enhancements to shipping, order entry, and billing functionalities within the enterprise system, optimizing business processes.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · SASS · React Native · Software Development · C#
